name: Post It
headline: PostIt: AI Content Generator for Social Media
short_description: PostIt is an AI-powered content generator for social media and SEO platforms, helping creators and marketers with content creation, niche research, keyword optimization, and meme generation. Built with Next.js, React.js, Tailwind CSS, Supabase, and Clerk.
author: JabulaniUsen

sections.overview:
PostIt is an AI-powered content generator built to streamline content creation for social media and SEO platforms. The tool enables content creators, influencers, and digital marketers to generate tailored content for Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube while conducting niche and keyword research to enhance SEO performance. Features include custom meme generation using the Imgflip API and keyword optimization capabilities powered by Gemini AI. The platform provides secure user authentication via Clerk and stores content in Supabase, offering a responsive, user-friendly interface for managing the entire content creation workflow.
Generate platform-specific content for Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, and YouTube
Conduct niche and keyword research to improve SEO rankings
Create custom memes for increased social media engagement
Manage and store generated content using integrated database
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/JabulaniUsen/post-it`
sections.usage:
```
Generate 5 engaging social media posts for [COMPANY] in the [INDUSTRY] industry. Include relevant hashtags and optimize for [PLATFORM]. Focus on [TOPIC] and incorporate [KEYWORD] naturally.
```
